property_summary: For any caller and any ETH value, the original contract C allows the Owner to forward arbitrary nonzero msg.value with Command to an external callee (call succeeds or at least is attempted with the passed value); the mutant incorrectly forbids any Command with nonzero msg.value, so there exist inputs (a nonzero value sent by Owner to Command) that make the mutant behave differently.
change_summary: Insert a require that msg.value must be zero before performing the call, changing when the call can be made and therefore observable behavior.
